acquisition_name: Official U.S. BLS CPI Schedule Evidence Acquisition Specification

acquisition_policy.third_party_calendars: REJECTED (Aggregators and financial blogs are not acceptable evidence)
acquisition_policy.search_snippets: REJECTED (Search engine summaries cannot establish causal provenance)
acquisition_policy.missing_evidence: Authentic byte-level official BLS schedule release calendar document

verification_requirements_upon_acquisiti: Raw byte preservation and immutable vault ingestion
Release family identification (Consumer Price Index - All Urban Consumers)
Reference period validation (ensuring reference month != release month)
Scheduled local time (08:30:00 AM Eastern Time)
Deterministic zoneinfo UTC conversion handling daylight saving transitions
Contemporaneous retrieval timestamp and operator identity logging
